task: It's time to explore the amazing world of TextWorld! Here is how to play! First off, make an effort to go east. With that over with, try to go south. Then, travel east. And then, go east. That done, make an effort to go to the east. And then, try to take a trip south. Next, move west. And then, go west. Then, move south. And then, attempt to take a trip west. And then, head north. Following that, make an attempt to travel west. With that accomplished, move south. With that accomplished, venture south. Okay, and then, try to go east. And then, look and see that the gateway is open. And then, make an effort to take a trip east. And then, pick-up the latchkey from the floor of the cubicle. Got that? Good!
description:
Well how about that, you are in a place we're calling a chamber.

As if things weren't amazing enough already, you can even see a portmanteau. Empty! What kind of nightmare TextWorld is this? Oh wow! Is that what I think it is? It is! It's a stand. The stand is standard. But the thing is empty.

There is an exit to the east. Don't worry, it is unguarded. There is an unguarded exit to the south.
